name: Hydrogen separator with the regular-solution model (plug-in)
description: Needs the example plug-in (examples/plugin), which provides the regular-solution property method. Hydrogen and methane over n-heptane and toluene are separated at 40 °C and 10 bar. The two gases are Henry components: they dissolve by Henry's law, and the regular-solution model describes the hydrocarbon liquid alone.
